scripts.test:integration: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/wp-checkpoint sh -c 'WPCHECKPOINT_TEST_LOOPBACK_HOST=http://tests-wordpress composer test:integration'
scripts.check:plugin: npm run build:dist && wp-env run cli wp plugin check wp-content/plugins/wp-checkpoint/build/wp-checkpoint --format=table
scripts.test:integration:multisite: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/wp-checkpoint sh -c 'WP_TESTS_MULTISITE=1 WPCHECKPOINT_TEST_LOOPBACK_HOST=http://tests-wordpress composer test:integration'
